texts: The lanterns of three Cliff Path stations burn extra mire-essence.

fields.sentence: The lanterns of three Cliff Path stations burn extra mire-essence.

q2_gaps: "extra" as a quantity increment on a bare mass-noun object ("burn extra mire-essence") — it is neither one of the fixed `Degree <N> quantity excessive/insufficient/sufficient` markers nor a comparative with a stated standard, so carrying it forces a witness plus `(Member sk_essence_1 extra)`, predicating the increment of the substance rather than of the amount
review.notes: "three Cliff Path stations" follows the Northgate-spokesman rule (head phrase parsed normally, opaque `Possession` to the named entity, `(Member cliff_path path)` from the kind word inside the name), and group + `(Cardinality 3)` + the per-member distribution rule at (STV 1.0 0.9), `Agent` for the inanimate transitive subject, `Patient` for the consumed object and the `mire_essence` head genus all match. One lantern group possessed by the station group flattens the per-station reading, but the instruction set supplies no dependent-plural machinery to do otherwise.

"Those stations" correctly resolves to the context group constant `sk_station_1`, and event-attached `Location` (not entity `LocatedIn`) is the right head for "at" on a happening; the unknown verb takes the licensed `(Member $e $verb)` shape. The group symbol is used as a unit, which is the instruction set's stated default for a plural.
